firstRunNotice.title: Welcome to CC Switch
firstRunNotice.bodyDefault: CC Switch lets you switch between multiple Claude Code / Codex / Pi providers with a single click. If you already had these tools configured, CC Switch has saved your existing setup as a provider named “default” so none of your previous configuration is lost.
firstRunNotice.bodyOfficial: An “Official” preset is also included in the list — click it any time you want to switch back to the official default. CC Switch automatically backs up your current config to “default” before switching, so you can move back and forth freely. That's how CC Switch works 😊

autoSync.title: Enable Auto Sync
autoSync.message:
When auto sync is enabled, every database change will be automatically uploaded to the WebDAV server.

This may result in significant network traffic. Please ensure your network and WebDAV service can handle frequent data transfers.

commonConfig.title: About Common Config
commonConfig.message:
The "Common Config Snippet" lets you share plugins, environment variables, and other settings across different providers — so they won't be lost when you switch.

How to use:
① Edit a provider → click "Edit Common Config" → "Extract from Editor"
② When creating a new provider, check "Apply Common Config" (enabled by default)

If you've newly installed plugins or hooks, re-extract the common config to keep them in sync.

unifyCodexHistory.title: Unified Codex session history
unifyCodexHistory.message:
When enabled, the official subscription and third-party providers share one session history list. Note: resuming an old session across providers may fail because its encrypted_content reasoning cannot be decrypted by another backend.

You can also migrate your existing official session history into the shared list (originals are backed up to ~/.cc-switch/backups first and can be restored when you turn this off).
unifyCodexHistory.migrateExisting: Also migrate existing official session history

unifyCodexHistoryOff.title: Turn off unified session history
unifyCodexHistoryOff.message: After turning this off, the official subscription and third-party providers return to separate history lists. Sessions created while it was on cannot be attributed to a provider, so they stay in the third-party history and the official subscription will not see them.
unifyCodexHistoryOff.restoreBackup: Restore the official sessions migrated at enable time back to the official history (exact restore from backup)
